def search_for_substring(s, pattern, start_pos):
    for i in range(start_pos, len(s) - len(pattern) + 1):
        if s[i] == pattern[0]:
            match_found = True
            for j in range(1, len(pattern)):
                if s[i + j] != pattern[j]:
                    match_found = False
                    break
            if match_found:
                return i
    return -1

def main():
    email_input = input().strip()
    at_pos = search_for_substring(email_input, "at", 1)
    temp_str = email_input[:at_pos] + '@' + email_input[at_pos + 2:]
    dot_pos = search_for_substring(temp_str, "dot", 1)
    last_pos = 0
    final_output = ''
    while dot_pos != -1 and dot_pos < len(temp_str) - 3:
        final_output += temp_str[last_pos:dot_pos] + "."
        last_pos = dot_pos + 3
        dot_pos = search_for_substring(temp_str, "dot", last_pos)
    final_output += temp_str[last_pos:]
    print(final_output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
